name: MCMC Expansion Inventory
summary: Provider refinements for Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and related Markov chain Monte Carlo CDGs.

operations.name: Detect Divergent Transitions
operations.intent: Expose HMC integration failures after the accept/reject decision.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a check for sampler proposals whose energy changed too much to trust.

rewrite.before_summary: Accepted and rejected proposals flow downstream without explicit divergence evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A divergence detector is inserted after the acceptance step.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds sampler-health evidence while preserving the chain output contract.

operations.name: Adapt Step Size
operations.intent: Tune leapfrog step size when acceptance behavior indicates unstable or inefficient proposals.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a warmup step that adjusts the sampler step size from acceptance feedback.

rewrite.before_summary: Leapfrog integration consumes a fixed step size.
rewrite.after_summary: A dual-averaging step-size adaptation stage runs before leapfrog integration.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Uses warmup acceptance evidence to select a more stable integration scale.

operations.name: Estimate Mass Matrix
operations.intent: Adapt HMC geometry when parameter scales differ materially.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a warmup estimate of parameter scales before leapfrog updates.

rewrite.before_summary: Leapfrog position updates use a default mass matrix.
rewrite.after_summary: A mass-matrix estimation stage is inserted before position updates.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Uses warmup samples to improve sampler geometry without changing target density semantics.

operations.name: Compute Convergence Diagnostics
operations.intent: Report whether chains have mixed sufficiently before downstream posterior use.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add R-hat and effective-sample-size checks after sampler transitions.

rewrite.before_summary: Samples may be consumed without explicit convergence evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: Convergence diagnostics are inserted after the acceptance step.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds chain quality evidence before posterior summaries are trusted.

audit.rationale: sciona-atoms owns foundational HMC, NUTS, and MCMC CDGs that map to matcher MCMC expansion rules.
audit.dejargonized_summary: These checks make MCMC pipelines report integration failures, tuning quality, parameter scaling, and chain convergence.

references.title: Matcher MCMC expansion rules
references.note: Rule names and trigger metrics mirror sciona/principal/expansion_rules/mcmc.py.
